preconditions.expression: Q == int(stdin.split()[0]) and Q >= 1 and Q <= 400000
preconditions.description: Q is the number of queries (1 ≤ Q ≤ 400000) and is the first line of input.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each query line (after the first) contains exactly three space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p) <= 10**18 and 1 <= int(q) <= 10**18 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for p, q in [line.split()[1:3]])
preconditions.description: For each query, p and q are integers in [1, 10^18].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= cnt for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: For type-2 queries, R (first integer) is a valid node index (1 ≤ R ≤ cnt).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**15 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: For type-2 queries, X (third integer) is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ X ≤ 10^15).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= cnt for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: For type-1 queries, R (second integer) is a valid node index (1 ≤ R ≤ cnt).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[3]) <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: For type-1 queries, W (third integer) is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ W ≤ 10^9).
Initially, the tree has one node (index 1) with weight 0, no parent, and no children.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in stdout.splitlines() for line in [stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(len(stdout.splitlines())) if i % 2 == 0])
postconditions.description: For each type-2 query, the output line corresponds exactly to the answer for that query (in order).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output) <= cnt for output in stdout.splitlines() if output.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output for a type-2 query is a non-negative integer ≤ current cnt.

postconditions.expression: all(len(sequence) == int(output) and sum(nodes[node]['weight'] for node in sequence) <= X and all(nodes[sequence[i]]['weight'] >= nodes[sequence[i+1]]['weight'] for i in range(len(sequence)-1)) and all(not any(nodes[k]['weight'] >= nodes[sequence[i+1]]['weight'] for k in path(sequence[i], sequence[i+1])) for i in range(len(sequence)-1)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2' for output in [stdout.splitlines()[int(line.split()[0]) - 1]] for sequence in find_sequences(line.split()[1], int(line.split()[2])) if len(sequence) == int(output))
postconditions.description:
For each type-2 query (R, X), the output is the maximum length of a sequence starting at R where:
1. Every node in the sequence is an ancestor of its predecessor.
2. Sum of weights ≤ X.
3. For consecutive nodes i, j (i ancestor of j), w[i] ≥ w[j] and no node k on the path from i to j has w[k] ≥ w[j].

postconditions.expression: all(nodes[cnt + 1] == {'weight': W, 'parent': R, 'children': []} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '1' for cnt, W, R in [(len(nodes), int(line.split()[3]), int(line.split()[2]))])
postconditions.description: For each type-1 query (p, q), a new node with index cnt+1, weight W = p XOR q, and parent R = p XOR q is added to the tree.

invariants.expression: all(nodes[node]['parent'] is None or nodes[node]['parent'] in nodes for node in nodes)
invariants.description: Every node's parent is either None (root) or a valid node in the tree.

invariants.expression: all(node in nodes[nodes[node]['parent']]['children'] if nodes[node]['parent'] is not None else True for node in nodes)
invariants.description: Every node (except root) is in its parent's children list.
